scope: S2-S4, attached Pico W; S5 and the complete S6 multi-board matrix remain separate
measurement_notes: Render cost is instrumented render_total_us divided by completed contributions, not optical output FPS or a sum of both CPU cores.
Five matched controls and five scalar/bulk pairs for each primary workload and worker count; additional workloads are single screens.
Poll-window gaps exclude full DESCRIPTION boundary queries; cumulative high-watermarks include uploads, admission, synchronous FRAME replay and startup.
One-worker initial 512 KiB storage build was rejected at upload and excluded; corrected build uses the original 1 MiB storage layout.
Startup Rainbow has one roughly 54 ms ingress gap on both baseline and candidate; settled follow-up separates that inherited behavior from kernel timing.
